title: SII Vol. 19 No. 98 — Tirumananjeri
location_detail: On the south wall of the central shrine, Udvahanathasavami temple

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 100 — Brahmadesam
location_detail: On the south wall of the central shrine, Chandramaulisvara temple

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 101
location_detail: On the same wall

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 102 — Tiruvenkadu
